methodology_note: WebSearch quota was exhausted, so no search-engine discovery. Figures come from pages fetched directly. TAXI is the strongest part: the Leh Taxi Union 2025-26 printed rate card (24 booklet pages) was downloaded as images from discoverwithdheeraj.com and read by eye, so every taxi figure below is a union fare, not a blogger estimate. STAY: Cleartrip Hunder/Diskit/Alchi/Sumur/Turtuk pages are for 13-14 Nov 2026 (pre-tax, discounted sale price; Nov is the off-season, most Nubra/Turtuk camps and hotels were SOLD OUT/closed, so only winter-capable properties show prices); other stay figures are single-blogger (Discover with Dheeraj, 2026 pages) ranges, mostly undated or 2019, and are labelled low confidence. FOOD: only one blogger menu survey (Discover with Dheeraj food guide, updated 6 Oct 2026) plus Wikivoyage; Tripadvisor shows price symbols only; Zomato timed out, restaurant-guru and MakeMyTrip/Booking pages returned empty or timed out and were not bypassed. USD->INR 96.8 (MTFX mid-market 8 Oct 2026, same rate as other batches). Leh stay omitted (stay_observed true).

taxi_day.basis: Union 'full day' (8 h) rate for an Innova/XUV on the 2025-26 card = 3,407; half day (4 h) = 1,703. Ladakh Taxi Operator Co-operative Ltd (Leh Taxi Union) printed 'Taxi Rate List for the year 2025-2026', applicable from 1 April 2025 (booklet pp.1-23, photographed pages hosted on discoverwithdheeraj.com). Innova/Aria/XUV column. 'Drop' = one-way fare (taxi returns empty), 'Return' = same-day round trip back to Leh. Official ladakhtaxiunion.com did not resolve (DNS failure), so the photographed card is the primary evidence. Card terms (p.23): full day = 8 h, half day = 4 h; full-day Innova/XUV 3,407 (Fortuner 4,122; Crysta/Scorpio-N 3,747; Xylo/Scorpio/Ertiga 3,237; Eeco/Van 2,935), half-day Innova/XUV 1,703; first waiting hour free then Rs 345/h; night halt Rs 385; AC on demand Rs 9/km paid to driver; extra detour up to 8 km Rs 345. Per-km tariff is not published: fares are fixed per route.
taxi_day.notes: Ladakh has no sedan class on the union card: cheapest class is Eeco/Van (full day 2,935), then Xylo/Scorpio/Ertiga 3,237, Innova/XUV 3,407, Crysta/Scorpio-N 3,747. The 8 h rate is the card's extra-day/full-day rate; most Leh sightseeing is sold as fixed packages (listed). Corroboration: Discover with Dheeraj summary table says 'Leh local sightseeing Rs 2,000-4,000' (page updated 17 Aug 2026), consistent with the card. That blog also says drivers booked directly often give 10-15% off, and agents add 10-15%. Outside-Ladakh taxis cannot do local sightseeing.

food_per_person_day.basis: Budget: simple breakfast ~150 + veg thukpa 100-180 or Neha-Snacks-type thali 120-250 + dinner at Tenzing Dickey/Norlakh 150-300 = ~550-650; blogger 'backpacker' band 500-800/day. Standard: cafe breakfast 150-300 (Jeevan Cafe) + lunch 150-300 + dinner at Gesmo 250-450 / Chopsticks 250-400 / Lamayuru restaurant 250-400 = ~800-1,050; blogger 'comfortable' band 1,000-1,500/day. Rounded to 600 and 1,000.
food_per_person_day.notes: Single-source menu survey (Discover with Dheeraj, 'Updated Oct 6, 2026'): veg thukpa 100-180, non-veg thukpa 180-280, momos (6-8) 80-180, skyu 200-400, butter tea 30-80; per-person restaurant spend: Tenzing Dickey 150-300, Norlakh 150-280, Gesmo 250-450, Alchi Kitchen 300-600, splurge Tsas by Dolkhar 800-1,500. Tripadvisor Leh list shows only price symbols (Neha Snacks/De Khambir/Crafty Beanz = low tier; most others mid tier), no rupee amounts. Wikivoyage (undated) puts a bazaar thali at about 100. Treat as ~+-25%.

unverified: Food: no second independent menu source (Zomato timed out; restaurant-guru had no Leh menu data); budget/standard are derived from one blogger survey
Official ladakhtaxiunion.com unreachable; the card was read from photographed pages, not the union's own site

stay.price_basis: MID: Cleartrip Hunder + Diskit, 1 night 13-14 Nov 2026, 2 guests, pre-tax discounted sale price, 3-star-tagged properties only: Hotel Real Siachen 1,385; The Snow Peak Hunder 1,778; Hotel Caravan Nubra 2,202; Hotel Onpo 2,368; The Wooden Nest 2,859; Himalayan Desert Villa 2,989; Nubra Leisure Camp 3,246; Hill Crest Nubra 3,582; Summer Retreat 4,005 (median 2,859; n=9). Excluded as outliers/other class: Stonehedge 17,771 (4-star), Stone Hedge 15,480 (5-star), Dream Ville 44,000, Shyok camp 24,150, Camp Silversand 9,492. BUDGET: Discover with Dheeraj 'Where to stay in Nubra' (page updated 14 Sep 2026, 'as of 2025-2026, verify locally') range MIDPOINTS for guesthouses: Olthang 1,500-2,500, Sand Dunes 1,000-1,800, Yourdum 1,200-1,800, Galaxy 1,500-2,500, Goba 1,200-1,800, Himalayan GH (attached bath) 1,500-2,000, Sumur A O 1,000-1,500, K-Sar 1,200-1,800 (median of midpoints 1,500). HOMESTAY: same blogger, 'Panamik homestays and guest houses 800-2,000' (midpoint 1,400, one range, no property names). DORM: Wikivoyage Nubra Valley: Himalayan Bunker (Hunder, 6-bed tents) 400, The Nunchi Huts & Hostel (Hunder) 500, 'hostels 400-500' as of 2023.
stay.notes: SEASON MATTERS: Nubra camps and most hotels run roughly June to early October (blogger: close by early October). The Cleartrip Nov dates therefore only show winter-capable hotels at discounted prices; the same pages show struck-through list prices for the same properties with median 4,375 (Wooden Nest 4,400, Desert Villa 4,375, Leisure Camp 4,800, Onpo 4,000, Hill Crest 5,400, Summer Retreat 4,500, Real Siachen 3,000, Caravan 3,500, Snow Peak 2,700). Peak (Jul-Aug) is dearer: blogger quotes Hotel Nubra Sarai Swiss-tent camp 3,400-4,350, Chamba Deluxe Camp 2,400-3,900, Sten Del (Diskit) 3,000-5,000, glamping camps 5,000-15,000+ per night in peak 'usually including meals'. Treat 2,859 as a shoulder/off-peak mid price and ~4,000-4,400 as a peak-season listed price for the same class. BUNDLING: village homestays and camps normally include dinner + breakfast; the blogger quotes homestay meals at 200-400 per meal; luxury camps 'with meals'. Wikivoyage (as of 2023) Turtuk-style homestays 700-1,000 per person incl. dinner and breakfast. CONFLICT (about 3x): TripClap 'onwards per night' (undated) lists TIH camps 6,490-7,139, Royal Riders Camp 4,720, MH Colours of Sumur Homestay 5,782, MH Rock Art Homestay 4,672, Wooden Nest 4,720; these look like branded/meal-inclusive rates and were NOT used (median of everything seen would be ~4,700 for homestays). The Cleartrip 2-star tier (Yeti Resort 2,527, Northern Valley Camp 2,812, Nubra Delight & Camps 2,976, Desert Oasis Camp 3,571; camps price like hotels) is not used for budget because blogger guesthouse ranges are lower. Leh district homestay registry (Jan 2025 PDF, no tariffs) confirms registered homestays at Hunder (Umbok) among others.
